items.statement: Stages distinguish affinity, stability and assay conditioning; Stage 2 output is log1p(hours), with full MHC sequences. Output transformation alone does not identify CSV encoding.
Stage 2 uses data/binding_stability; log_transform=true, stability_score=false, val_subsample=0.
Reads train/val/test CSVs and applies log1p once before constructing datasets. A different CLI override could change this configuration.

Shared dataset returns peptide, full MHC sequence and label without another target transform. Collation casts labels to float32 and replaces sequence J with L during tokenization; audit joins preserve original strings.
Documents raw Stage 2 CSV half-life inputs and full alpha-chain sequences. Actual released rows additionally carry allele, assay and temperature fields.
Pinned Allele/Full Sequence table supports exact reference lookup. It does not establish construction version, experimental material equivalence, or mutant-to-wild-type identity.

label_evidence: src/README.md:35-38,85; train_stability.py:410-425: CSV labels are inputs to log1p, not pre-transformed labels. Released values independently compared to DTU hours in this audit.
limitations: No data-preparation, normalization, sequence-reference construction or split-construction script was found in the pinned tracked tree. Upstream reference release and preparation history remain unspecified.
Exact row/value overlap demonstrates reuse of the DTU representation, not independent experiments or independently confirmed row-level measurement origin.
No Stage 1/3 data or predictions were examined, and the preprint's 80% similarity and cross-task leakage claims are not verified by this exact-overlap audit.
No synthetic or censoring label is inferred from numerical zeros. C67S identifiers are never mapped automatically to wild-type.

Some released/reference MHC strings have 181 residues despite full-chain documentation. Exact named-reference agreement is not a full-chain completeness or experimental-material verification; no sequence completion is applied.

preprint.limitations: Confirmed from primary-page search-index text; direct retrieval returned 403 and no byte-exact article snapshot is available. These are preprint claims, not proof of released preprocessing execution. Data availability names pirl-unc/spearmint; this task pins the requested dhuvik/spearmint checkout.

preprint.statement: The preprint attributes stability data to NetMHCstabpan and reports allele normalization/full-sequence mapping, log1p modeling, and peptide-cluster splits at 80% identity. It reports 27034 overall but split counts sum to 27031.
